note.text: One to two intraoral photos Sarah captured on her phone through the Meridian teledentistry app during the virtual visit, reviewed by Dr. Webb and sent with the referral. Modeled as a US Core DocumentReference (the R5/R6-forward, US-Core-conformant vehicle for non-DICOM clinical images — chosen over R4 Media, which is removed in R5/R6 and has no US Core profile). Inline base64 (content.attachment.data) is a SHORT placeholder for test data; a production submission carries the full image/jpeg bytes inline so the artifact is self-contained for the CDex push to Barton Springs' interim FHIR server (no reach-back pull required). This is explicitly NOT a diagnostic radiograph: no DICOM, no ImagingStudy, no WADO-RS/PACS — the radiograph first appears in-office at Interaction 3. The affected tooth (#19) is carried on Observation/observation-symptoms (bodySite) which references these photos via derivedFrom, since R4 DocumentReference has no bodySite element.
